figurative_meaning_en: Characters in a play or drama
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই নাটকে কুশীলবরা অসাধারণ অভিনয় করেছে।
কুশীলবদের ভূমিকা ছাড়া গল্পটি অসম্পূর্ণ লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: The Kush-Lav characters in this play performed exceptionally well.
The story feels incomplete without the roles of the Kush-Lav figures.
history: Derived from the Ramayana epic, where Kush and Lav, the twin sons of Rama and Sita, recite the story of their father's life, symbolizing narrative performers or secondary characters in dramatic retellings.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu mythology, often used in contexts of storytelling and performance in Bengali culture.
